title: useQueryParams
description:
Implement `useQueryParams` — a hook that reads URL query parameters and provides a setter that merges updates and writes back via `history.replaceState`.

**Example:**
```tsx
const [params, setParams] = useQueryParams({ page: '1', sort: 'asc' });
// reads ?page=1&sort=asc from URL
setParams({ page: '2' }); // URL becomes ?page=2&sort=asc
```
ai_context: Common mistake: calling window.location.search directly in the render function body on every render instead of in useState initializer. This causes a synchronous window read each render, and won't re-read if the URL changes externally. The initializer runs only once.
